notes.title: Show 'em what you're made of in Madden NFL 24
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4o6xDjg2B54;full][/previewyoutube]

All the latest next generation features in Madden NFL 24 are coming to PC. More realistic character movement and smarter AI helps you strategize and compete with the best. 

FieldSENSE™ is now in the PC version of Madden NFL 24, including all the new improvements. FieldSENSE now gives players more control when catching, blocking, throwing, and tackling with fresh animations added to Skill-Based Passing 2.0 and Hit Everything 2.0. 

Skill-Based Passing 2.0 overhauls the catching system, so that receiving feels smoother and more realistic; you can hit a receiver in stride and he can continue his momentum and speed. New Jump, Dive, and no-look pass animations have been added for improvisational quarterbacks. 

Hit Everything 2.0 introduces new contested catch tackle types that make defensive moves more realistic. 

All-new SAPIEN Technology rebuilds character models to be anatomically correct and transforms the way players look and move. The new SAPIEN Skeleton is based on modern NFL superstars, improving the fluidity of their movement and simulating realistic athletic performance. 

AI Enhancements are also applied all over the field: offense, defense, and blocking AI will make you more confident in every AI teammate so you can focus on making big plays. 

FieldSENSE™ animation branching tech enables dynamic chip-blocking and movement in-and-out of double teams on the fly, anywhere on the field with all-new blocking AI. The Frostbite™ Navigation Grid makes AI Ball Carriers more aware of everything on the field, so they make clear and obvious decisions based on what's happening. AI QBs are also more advanced to have similar playstyles to their real-life counterparts, based on their specific style of play. 

Pre-purchase* the Madden NFL 24 Standard Edition to get the following: 

Josh Allen Elite player item
NFL Marble Bills Gear
Choice of Strategy Item (Offense or Defense) 

Pre-purchase the Madden NFL 24 Deluxe Edition and score: 

AKA player item (if you pre-order by July 22)
3 Days Early Access
4600 Madden Points

NFL Marble Bills Gear
Choice of Strategy Item (Offense or Defense)

notes.title: EA corrupt 60% of Madden 23 saves for players who logged in during two days last week
notes.content:
EA have dropped the ball. If you logged into Madden NFL 23 during at least a 22-hour period last week, there's a good chance your Connected Franchise Mode saves have been permanently corrupted. If that wasn't galling enough, the corrupting period (from Wednesday December 28th to Thursday 29th) came immediately after EA gave people the go ahead to log in.

EA have said they expect to recover 40% of the saves, the wallies.

Read more

notes.title: Madden 23 SSL error - EA says 60% of Franchise data can't be recovered
notes.content:
The Madden 23 SSL error, which has made it impossible for players to access CFM mode in the NFL sports game, has likely resulted in a permanent loss of 60% of player Franchise data, with EA issuing an apology and outlining plans for data recovery.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: PlayStation 5 and Madden 23 take August - NPD
notes.content:
The NPD Group has released its August 2022 report covering video game hardware, software, and accessory sales in the US.

According to the NPD, total videogame industry spending declined 5% year-over-year (yoy) to $4.10 billion. Year-to-date spending sits at $34.6 billion, a 9% decline yoy.

For the month of August, hardware sales grew by 14% yoy to $375 million, helped by improved supply of PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles. Year-to-date hardware spending declined by 4% to $2.9 billion.

notes.title: Madden NFL 23 PC version won't have next-gen features
notes.content:
Just as it did with last year's edition of the American football game, EA Sports has opted to make the Madden NFL 23 PC edition a port of the last-gen console version, putting it in line with the Xbox One and PlayStation 4 experiences. That means this year's Madden game will lack some of the flashy new features EA's been highlighting in Madden this year.

One of those is the new 'FieldSense' animation and physics system, which EA Sports says allows players to 'hit anything' and provides enhanced control over player movement and actions. FieldSense drives some of Madden NFL 23's other new features, such as skill-based passing and 360 cuts, but those will all be missing on the PC edition of the game.

Last year, EA Sports said it was porting the Xbox One/PlayStation 4 version of Madden 22 to PC rather than the current-gen version because "the team is focused on making the best, quality experience on new consoles before looking to upgrade other platforms." It appears that this remains the case for the 2023 edition.
